Title: Sancti Hilarii Pictaviensis episcopi Opera omnia juxta editionem monachorum Ordinis Sancti Benedicti e Congregatione S. Mauri et omnes alias inter se collatas, reproducta, emendata, singulariter aucta. Tomus posterior (Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, tomus X)
Creator: Hilary of Poitiers (c. 315-367); Jacques-Paul Migne (ed.), after the Maurist edition of Pierre Coustant and the Verona edition of Scipione Maffei
Publisher: Parisiis: excudebat Vrayet (Migne's printer; 'S. HILARII TOMUS POSTERIOR. PARISIIS, EXCUDEBAT VRAYET' at file lines 91-92)
Publication Date: 1844 (archive.org catalogue date; the year is not legible in the OCR of the title page; this Patrologia Latina volume is conventionally dated 1845)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: a mid-nineteenth-century Migne printing, catalogued 1844); the archive.org record tags it NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT
Language: lat (Latin; the OCR is readable in the running text with frequent letter errors, and the Patrologia's double-spaced word breaks are preserved; the volume's few Greek words were not recovered as Greek script)
Source: archive.org item patrologiaecurs197unkngoog (digitized by Google; catalogue volume 10 of the Patrologia Latina), full text at https://archive.org/download/patrologiaecurs197unkngoog/patrologiaecurs197unkngoog_djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-10-17 by the Shared-Events source-research thread (Era 2 worker A); the byte count of the downloaded file (3,940,832) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected, so Google's scan notice, library stamps and OCR errors remain as scanned. Rights basis: Migne's Patrologia Latina volume 10 is an 1844/1845 Paris printing, out of US copyright under this project's pd-us-by-date rule; the host's NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT tag is supporting evidence.
Content note: The second Hilary volume of the Patrologia Latina (the first, PL 9, holds the Psalms commentary and the Matthew commentary and is not vendored). By its own table of contents (file lines 173, 189) and headings it carries the Liber de Synodis seu de fide Orientalium (file line 38488; the Latin behind the English On the Councils in npnf209_hilary-poitiers-john-damascus.xml), the Liber I ad Constantium Augustum (file line 45057) and Liber II ad Constantium (file line 45637), the Liber contra Constantium imperatorem (file line 46205; Hilary's own denunciation of the emperor after Ariminum, Seleucia and Constantinople 360), the Contra Auxentium (file line 48549), and the fifteen Fragmenta ex opere historico (Fragmentum I at file line 50120, II at 50422, III at 53435, XV at 57700), the older edition of the dossier re-edited by Feder in CSEL 65 (vendored alongside). Maurist prefaces and notes are interleaved and are eighteenth-century scholarship, not evidence.
